Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, when the vehicle was struck from the side. The
mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the cervical and lumbar strain reported. Initial complaints included
neck stiffness, paraspinal tenderness, and low back pain with limited range of motion. Examination revealed some
objective findings supporting soft tissue injury, including reduced cervical rotation and muscle guarding, while other
orthopedic and neurological tests were within normal limits. No prior injury to the neck or low back is known from the
history obtained. Care was delivered over twenty visits consisting of manual therapy, guided exercise, and home
stretching instructions. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms improved
and range of motion returned. Billing records reflect one charge per scheduled service with no duplicate entries. At
discharge the patient was improving and was advised to continue a home program as needed.
